user.title: Restart Guard
user.description: Warns you in Home Assistant's own restart dialog when a timed automation is about to run.

data.warn_window: Warn if an automation is due within
data.min_interval: Ignore automations repeating more often than
data.stale_run: Stop blocking on a run still going after
data.check_conditions: Stay quiet when conditions can't pass

data_description.warn_window: How close counts as too close to restart.
data_description.lookahead: Automations further out than this are not tracked.
data_description.min_interval: Stops every-5-minutes automations from warning constantly.
data_description.stale_run: An automation part-way through a run always warns you, because restarting cuts it off. But one still going after this long is probably parked in a wait_for_trigger, so it is listed without requiring the second tap.
data_description.check_conditions: Don't warn about an automation that would fire and do nothing, because its conditions don't pass or no choose branch matches. Turn this off to warn about every scheduled run regardless.
data_description.track_schedules: Include schedules from the Scheduler component (nielsfaber). Only enabled schedules count - a disabled one keeps publishing a next trigger time it will never act on.
